title: OpenAI Introduces Voice Assistant Feature to ChatGPT Mobile App, Full Series Supports Cross-Platform Voice Work

content_html:
On Wednesday, OpenAI announced the official introduction of the ChatGPT voice agent feature to mobile devices, allowing users to initiate complex workflows such as drafting documents and summarizing emails through direct voice commands. This update marks OpenAI's accelerated effort to expand desktop-level AI productivity tools to mobile scenarios, aligning with the industry trend of using natural voice-driven AI assistants to perform advanced tasks.

In terms of specific functionality layers, Plus and Pro subscribers can use the "Work" tab on their mobile devices to overcome device limitations and complete core office needs such as document creation, email writing, and Slack message summaries. They can also perform advanced operations like website building, presentation generation, cloud browser access, and financial tool access.

At the same time, Free and Go plan users can also use various plugins and connected applications with this feature. To optimize the user experience, the ChatGPT mobile voice conversation will output more diverse text formats. Users can seamlessly switch between voice and text input, and can start a conversation on their mobile device and smoothly transition it to their computer for continued use.

The underlying technical support for this mobile agent capability comes from OpenAI's new dialogue model, GPT-Live, released in July of this year. Previously, this model was first integrated into the desktop version, empowering users to build applications and handle tasks through voice in the "Work" or "Code Repository" tabs. This mobile upgrade further completes its full-scenario product ecosystem.

Notably, in terms of product evolution, unlike Anthropic, which recently chose to merge collaboration office and chat interfaces to simplify multi-device switching, OpenAI continues to strictly separate regular chat interactions from professional work areas. This differentiated product approach indicates that OpenAI is trying to further strengthen its competitive advantage in the enterprise and professional AI office market by reinforcing clearer functional segmentation and stronger mobile voice agent capabilities.
